summary.text: Nick Allen is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 8 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A West Point graduate and U.S. Army veteran, he works as a program manager at the Maryland Department of Health and sits on the House Environment and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Allen was born in 1990, graduated from Mount St. Joseph High School in 2007, and earned a bachelor's degree in arts, philosophy and literature from the United States Military Academy at West Point in 2011.

He served as an Army officer, including as a troop and squadron fire support officer with the 3rd Squadron, 7th U.S. Cavalry, at Fort Stewart, Georgia, from 2012 to 2014, and as executive officer of a reachback detachment from 2014 to 2016.

He then worked as a maintenance supervisor at the Detroit-Hamtramck Assembly Paint Shop and a quality assurance manager for General Motors from 2017 to 2019, a supply chain leader for GES Warehouse in Aberdeen, Maryland, and a fleet manager for PepsiCo in Aberdeen from 2020 to 2021.
Since 2021 he has been a program manager at the Maryland Department of Health.
Allen was elected to the House in November 2022 and took office on January 11, 2023.

He serves on the Environment and Transportation Committee and its Energy, Motor Vehicle and Transportation, and Non-Energy Utilities subcommittees, is a Deputy Majority Whip, and is the House chair of the Joint Subcommittee on Program Open Space and Agricultural Land Preservation.
He also serves on the Joint Committee on the Chesapeake and Atlantic Coastal Bays Critical Area.
He was one of three incumbents who won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for the district's three seats.
